about: Strelva Reborn section 7. Boundary imports that existed on 2026-10-06; this list only shrinks. Fix an entry, then run pnpm check:boundaries --prune. Never add one: src/lib -> workspace imports are never allowed, and a new workspace -> src/lib import means the code belongs in src/platform/infra or the workspace layer.
